{{Quote|I said ''move it'', didn't I? You deaf or something? Clear the corridor! Armed police!|CSF Captain Jaller Obrim issuing orders to the medcenter staff|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
A '''standoff''' occurred in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] at the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]] when [[Republic Treasury Audit Division|Republic Treasury]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Besany Wennen]] discovered that the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] intended to euthanize [[Fi Skirata]] since they had declared him brain-dead. Wennen threatened the medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], forced them out of Fi's hospital room, and shot the lock to seal herself and Fi inside. In the resulting standoff, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF), a friend of Wennen, responded with several CSF [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and half of the shift from the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]]. In a large display of weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], Obrim and the CSF entered the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], stormed the hallway, and escorted Wennen and Fi out of the room.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Then you'll need to have me thrown out&ndash;bodily. I'm not going quietly, and I'm not leaving without Fi|Besany Wennen to medcenter staff|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
On a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] to [[Gaftikar]], [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] sustained a serious [[Brain/Legends|brain]] injury and was taken to Coruscant's [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]]. [[Kal Skirata]] asked [[Republic Treasury Audit Division|Republic Treasury]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Besany Wennen]] to keep an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on Fi, and she discovered that the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] intended to euthanize Fi since they had declared him brain-dead.

==Standoff==
[[File:Holdinghandsm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Fi Skirata in Jaller Obrim's apartment]]
{{Quote|Ask your chief executive about his interest in Twi'lek artistic pursuits on every fourth of the month, and if he'd like me to give police surveillance holovids of the visits to the cultural center to his lovely wife. Your call.|Captain Jaller Obrim, dealing with an obstructing administrative medical droid|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
Wennen threatened the medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], forced them out of Fi's hospital room, and shot the lock to seal herself and Fi inside. In the resulting standoff, Skirata called [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] for a rescue, and Obrim responded with several CSF patrol officers and half of the shift from the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]]. In a large display of weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], Obrim and the CSF stormed the hallway and escorted Wennen and Fi out of the room with the assistance of [[Coruscant Security Force paramedic|CSF paramedics]]. When they reached the lobby, they were stopped by a medical droid who insisted they had no right to remove the [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] Fi. Threatening that he would release embarrassing information about the droid's boss, Obrim was able to secure Fi's release. Along with Wennen, they left the medical center under the loyal and watchful gaze of the CSF officers whose lives Fi had saved during the Galactic City Spaceport hostage siege.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I'll make it go away. I'm CSF. I can make all kinds of things go away when I need to.|Jaller Obrim, to Besany Wennen|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />}}
Fi was taken to [[Jaller Obrim's residence]] where he was cared for by a medical droid Obrim had rented. Fi was later covertly moved to the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
